'''Toshiyuki Morikawa''' (Japanese: '''森川智之''' ''Morikawa Toshiyuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Morikawa was born on January 26, 1967 in {{wp|Shinagawa}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He began his work in the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|OS}}, playing various roles, one of them being [[Sabrina's Haunter]]. Later, he provided the voice of former [[Hoenn]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Wallace]] during {{aniseries|DP}}. Morikawa is currently affiliated with the talent agency Axlone, and he also formed a band with fellow voice actor [[Fumihiko Tachiki]], called "2HEARTS".
